turns.text: I reported a scrape on the print, and your reply said it was part of the artwork. It's a raised scratch across the ink. I'd like to dispute that decision.
I’m sorry the raised scratch was dismissed as part of the artwork. I’ve passed your dispute to a colleague who will take over and review the original decision.

input.summary: Customer disputes the prior decision on a reported scrape: they were told it was part of the artwork, but describe a raised scratch across the ink. Please review the original damage decision. No order number or email provided.
